svg.aria-label: Block diagram of the P25 Orb receive architecture: three antenna elements pass through couplers and bandpass filters in the band module, cross the dock, are amplified and split, and feed an uplink coherent group and a downlink coherent group, which merge into an FPGA bridge and application compute.
